name: snapp-mcp

tools.name: find_location
tools.description:
Turn a place name or address into latitude/longitude.

    Use first when the user gives an address instead of coordinates; every food_* and
    market_* tool needs lat/long. Results are biased toward near_lat/near_long
    (default Tehran), so pass a city center for other cities.

query.description: Place, street, landmark or neighbourhood, Persian works best, e.g. 'میدان ونک'.
query.title: Query

near_lat.description: Bias results toward this latitude (e.g. a city center from list_cities).
near_lat.title: Near Lat

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description:
Describe coordinates in words (point of interest, street, neighbourhood).

    Use to confirm a delivery point with the user before searching.

lat.description: Latitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~25 to ~40).
lat.title: Lat

long.description: Longitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~44 to ~63).
long.title: Long

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description:
List cities Snappfood serves, with id, names and center coordinates.

    Use the center coordinates as a rough delivery point when the user only names a city.

query.description: Optional filter on the Persian title or English code, e.g. 'شیراز' or 'Shiraz'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: food_search
tools.description:
Search dishes by name near a delivery point, with price, discount and restaurant.

    Use for "find X near me" or "discounted X". With sort=relevance it is one fast call
    on the search index; cheapest / biggest_discount also drop side items (sauces,
    drinks, extras) and confirm prices against the live menus. For the cheapest X across
    many restaurant menus use food_find_cheapest.

query.description: Dish or food word, Persian works best, e.g. 'پیتزا', 'کباب'.
query.title: Query

lat.description: Latitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~25 to ~40).
lat.title: Lat

long.description: Longitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~44 to ~63).
long.title: Long

include_protein.description: Also search protein stores (butchers, poultry, eggs), which are hidden by default.
include_protein.title: Include Protein

tools.name: food_find_cheapest
tools.description:
Find the cheapest way to get a dish: scans menus of nearby open restaurants plus FoodParty deals.

    Use when the user wants the lowest total price for X. Ranks by total =
    food price after discount + packaging + delivery fee; check min_order, since a cheap
    dish may not reach the restaurant's minimum basket. Slower than food_search.

query.description: Dish or food word, Persian works best, e.g. 'پیتزا', 'کباب'.
query.title: Query

lat.description: Latitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~25 to ~40).
lat.title: Lat

long.description: Longitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~44 to ~63).
long.title: Long

max_restaurants.description: How many open restaurants' menus to scan (more = slower, more complete).
max_restaurants.title: Max Restaurants

tools.name: food_restaurants
tools.description:
List restaurants delivering to a point, with rating, delivery fee, ETA and coupon info.

    Use to browse or rank restaurants (best rated, free delivery, with discount) or to
    find a restaurant's vendor code by name. No dish prices: use food_menu for those.

lat.description: Latitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~25 to ~40).
lat.title: Lat

long.description: Longitude of the delivery point (Iran: ~44 to ~63).
long.title: Long

query.description: Filter by restaurant name, e.g. 'پیتزا' or a brand name.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Order; least_expensive/most_expensive rank by price class, not delivery fee.
sort.title: Sort

open_only.description: Hide restaurants that are closed or don't deliver here.
open_only.title: Open Only

tools.name: food_menu

Get one restaurant's menu: every item with price, discount, packaging fee and availability.

    Use after picking a restaurant (vendor code from food_search / food_restaurants).
    final_price = price - discount; packaging is added per item at checkout.

    Per-item packaging fees are in food_menu.

instructions:
Unofficial, read-only access to Snappfood (restaurant delivery, snappfood.ir) and SnappMarket
(grocery delivery, snapp.market) in Iran. Nothing here can log in, add to a basket or order.

Workflow:
1. Get coordinates: find_location (address/landmark) or list_cities (city center). All food_* and
   market_* tools need lat/long because menus, prices and delivery depend on the delivery point.
2. Food: food_search / food_find_cheapest for dishes, food_restaurants for restaurants,
   food_menu for one restaurant, food_order_costs before recommending (delivery fee, minimum
   order, coupons), deals via food_party_deals / food_meal_for_one / food_discounted_vendors.
3. Groceries: market_search / market_find_cheapest, market_stores, market_store_info,
   market_store_products, market_party_deals.

Conventions: prices are Toman (1 Toman = 10 Rial). Ratings are 0-5. Vendor codes look like
'947evd'. Persian queries match best ('پیتزا', 'شیر'). True cost of a food order =
price - discount + packaging + delivery fee - coupon, and the basket must reach the minimum order.
